rules.last_session: PROVISIONAL: touched threads and standalone beats with narrative_impact and lasting_consequence both medium or high; story order; no cap
rules.want: serves_thread is null (an end, not a means) and significance is not incidental (Goals: parent_goal_id null, significance not incidental)
rules.owe: definite_end; commitment_type is not general_agreement; stake, burden and consequence are not trivial (Obligations filter)
rules.blocked_by: in_effect is active (Goal Impediments: anticipated filtered out)
rules.could_use: helps_thread names a thread whose want or debt is shown, directly or through a parent thread (Opportunities and New Assets need a goal link); role is direct (Opportunities: parent_opportunity_id null); an asset with low or trivial goal_support is shown only if acquired by acting on an opening (New Assets filter)
rules.unknown: question_type open_ended and all four dimensions medium or high (Mysteries filter)
rules.threat: harm_origin is not party and no evaluation is low (Brewing Troubles filter); not covered by an immediate danger
rules.all: never possibly moot facts; no caps

last_session_candidates.change: The party arrived in Brandonsford following a treasure map whose marked locations they did not recognize.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The single beat establishes the map as the reason for the journey but reveals no new locations or clues.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The unfound treasure is the party's underlying goal and will drive later exploration.

last_session_candidates.change: Reginald warned the party that a trickster called a Clurichen comes from the riverbanks into town every night up to no good.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: One warning introduces a new nightly danger in town without any encounter yet.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The Clurichen ties into the vanishing stock and Sir Phidipaldi's claims, so it is likely to come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: Eric the Reeve offered 1000 gold to whoever kills the small black dragon that took George's arm, though Sir Phidipaldi then insulted him and challenged him to a duel.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The bounty, George's description of the black dragon, Gill's sighting and his sons' hunt give the party a major new goal and foe, while the slap strained relations with the bounty-giver.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The dragon bounty is the town's central problem and will shape later Sessions, and the strained relationship with Eric may matter when claiming it.

last_session_candidates.change: Lady Hilda, a seasoned armored fighter, offered to join the party for money, and Sir Phidipaldi said they would come back for her services.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Her offer gives the party a potential capable ally for the dragon hunt, though no deal was made.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Sir Phidipaldi promised to return to her, so she is likely to come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: The murderous thief Drop Dead Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for hire at 100 gold a week, and Dr. Uriah said he would think about it.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: The offer introduces a dangerous potential hireling, but nothing was agreed.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Dr. Uriah left the offer open, so Ned is likely to reappear.

last_session_candidates.change: The party learned that Brandonsford's restocking shipment is a week overdue and nothing has reached town in months, and Sir Phidipaldi agreed to stage a fake ale delivery with Quinn.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Bentley's and Gill's accounts reveal a town-wide supply crisis, and the staged delivery plan is a concrete step toward it.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The planned fake delivery and the link to the dragon make it likely the shipment will come up again.

last_session_candidates.change: Bentley stopped the argument with Eric and made Sir Phidipaldi spend the night across the street at the Golden Egg, with his drink on the house.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Bentley's intervention separated Sir Phidipaldi from the party for one night.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The arrangement covers only that night and is unlikely to matter later.

last_session_candidates.change: Farmer Gill offered Dunk his mule Shamus for 100 gold or work such as killing the dragon, and Dunk is sleeping on the offer in Gill's barn.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: An unresolved purchase offer and a night's lodging slightly adjust Dunk's situation.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: Dunk is still considering the offer, so it may come up again, but it is a minor matter.

last_session_candidates.change: The party learned that the paranoid smith Warwick displays a superb mithril chain shirt he refuses to sell.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: Gill's description adds a coveted item and some town gossip about Warwick and Ingrid but no change in access.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The shirt is a possible future goal, but nothing was set in motion.

last_session_candidates.change: Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help Quinn get back at Bentley for 100 gold, starting with a staged fake ale delivery to find out what is taking Quinn's stock each night.
last_session_candidates.impact_basis: A paid agreement was struck and a plan made around the mystery of the vanishing stock.
last_session_candidates.lasting_basis: The deal and the planned stunt will play out in later Sessions.
